name: HOK ~H na Koto de Okane Kasegi!?~
source:
Hana is a high society elite girl.
When her fortune is lost in a national coup d'etat,
she has to learn how to make her own way.

Others were executed; she's lucky she only has to kill her dignity!

Can Hana make a happy, fulfilling future spreading her pretty legs?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ179737.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
